description: This file contains the implementation of a generic durable task completion source, including interfaces, classes for managing task lifecycle, state persistence, and serialization logic within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: DurableTaskCompletionSource
classes.description: A generic class implementing a durable task completion source with serialized state management, supporting cancellation, exception, and result setting, designed for use in Orleans state machines.

classes.name: DurableTaskCompletionSourceStatus
classes.description: Enum representing the current status of the DurableTaskCompletionSource (Pending, Completed, Faulted, Canceled).

classes.name: DurableTaskCompletionSourceState
classes.description: Immutable struct capturing the serialized state of the task, including status, result value, and exception details.

methods.name: TrySetResult
methods.description: Attempts to set the task result if the current state is pending.

methods.name: TrySetException
methods.description: Attempts to set an exception for the task if the current state is pending.

methods.name: TrySetCanceled
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the task if the current state is pending.

methods.name: OnValuePersisted
methods.description: Internal method called when the state is persisted to complete the task accordingly.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Deserializes and applies a log entry to restore the completion source state.

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes and writes the current state of the completion source to the log or snapshot.
